examine_breakable_grass: A tuft of grass. Maybe there's a cigarette somewhere in there?
examine_reactive_flower: A strange flower. It looks like it could use a good scratch.
examine_breakable_urn: A clay urn. Something rattles inside. One good scratch would crack it.
examine_pantry_jar: A squat clay jar. Something shifts inside. A scratch would crack it.
examine_jar_shelf: A shelf of jars. The jars look breakable. The shelf does not.
examine_jar_shelf_empty: An empty shelf. Whatever was in the jars is on the floor now.
examine_ship_captain_chest: The captain's chest. Locked, but the lid is old wood. A good scratch might do it.
examine_desert_ruin_chest: A heavy old chest, sitting in the courtyard like it's waiting. The lid looks like it would give to a good scratch.
examine_desert_ruin_chest_open: An open chest. Sand is already getting in.
examine_chult_falls_chest: A chest, out here, where nobody comes. The lid's gone soft in the damp. One good scratch.
examine_chult_falls_chest_open: An open chest. Moss is already moving in.
examine_barrel: A barrel. Far too sturdy to break with a scratch.
examine_crate: A shipping crate, nailed shut. Too big to break with a scratch.
examine_crate_green: A crate painted green. Too big to break with a scratch.
examine_crate_orange: A crate painted orange. Too big to break with a scratch.
examine_crate_red: A crate painted red. Too big to break with a scratch.
examine_bar_counter: The bar. Scratched plenty already, and none of it by rats.
examine_tavern_table: A tavern table. Solid oak. A scratch won't do anything to it.
examine_tavern_chair: A chair. Much too big to break with a scratch.
examine_chimney: A chimney. It is smoking more than Chuck is.
examine_stall_post: A stall post holding up the awning.
examine_stall_table: A market table. Too heavy to break with a scratch.
examine_sailing_cog: A whole ship, sitting in the jungle. Nobody here seems to think that's strange.
examine_waterdeep_fountain: A fountain. The water's clean, which is more than can be said for the harbour.
examine_waterdeep_forge: The smith's forge. Hot enough to feel from here.
examine_waterdeep_anvil: An anvil. Much too heavy to do anything to with a scratch.
examine_waterdeep_alchemist_display: Bottles of things with labels written by someone in a hurry.
examine_desert_column: A broken column. Stone. A scratch won't move it.
examine_desert_column_fallen: A fallen column, lying where it came down. Too heavy to break with a scratch.
examine_desert_rubble: A pile of fallen blocks. Too big to break with a scratch.
examine_desert_great_pillar: A great pillar, still standing. The building it held up isn't.
examine_desert_ruin_arch: The gate arch. The one part of the building that didn't fall down.
examine_castle_turret: A turret on the corner of the wall.
examine_phlegethos_rubble: Basalt rubble, still warm. Too heavy to break with a scratch.
examine_phlegethos_lava_fall: A waterfall, but it's lava. Best not.
examine_phlegethos_statue: A statue of something with too many horns.
examine_temple_column: A temple column. Solid stone. A scratch won't do anything.
examine_temple_arch_ew: A stone arch, carved with serpents.
examine_temple_arch_ns: A stone arch, carved with serpents.
examine_phlegethos_arch_ew: An iron-banded gate. The stone is cracked, and the cracks are lit.
examine_phlegethos_arch_ns: An iron-banded gate. The stone is cracked, and the cracks are lit.
examine_temple_idol: An idol with a very fixed stare.
examine_temple_monument: A carved monument. The carvings are of people running.
examine_temple_serpent_monument: A monument shaped like a coiled serpent.
examine_temple_serpent_head: A stone snake's head, big enough to walk into. Its mouth is open.
examine_temple_roof_comb: Carved stone standing off the roof, pierced right through. It is up there to be seen from down here.
examine_temple_stela: A stone slab covered in writing nobody reads any more.
examine_temple_rubble_block: A fallen block of temple wall. Too big to break with a scratch.
examine_skull_stake: A skull on a stake. A warning, probably.
examine_feywild_tree: A tree with leaves that glow faintly.
examine_feywild_grove_tree: A tree, with a violet sheen on its leaves.
examine_feywild_oak: An oak. A completely ordinary oak. It stands out here.
examine_feywild_spiral: A very large flower. Doesn't seem like it does anything, unlike those other flowers
examine_feywild_mushroom: A mushroom the size of a table.
examine_feywild_great_tree: A tree older than anything else in the Feywild.
examine_fey_root_knot: A knot of roots, grown round each other.
examine_fey_table_leg: A table leg, the size of a tree.
examine_fey_napkin: A napkin the size of a bedsheet.
examine_fey_crumbs: Crumbs. Each one is about the size of Chuck's head.
examine_cloud_staircase: A staircase made of cloud. It holds.
examine_cloud_tower_arch: The archway into the tower. It's big enough for a giant, because it is for one.
examine_griffon_nest: A griffon's nest. Best not be in it.
examine_aerie_rope: A rope as thick as a tree trunk.
examine_redcap_shelter: A redcap shelter. It smells like old boots.
examine_redcap_cauldron: A cauldron. Whatever's in it is still bubbling. Too heavy to tip with a scratch.
examine_redcap_boot: An iron boot, sized for a redcap. Too heavy to budge with a scratch.
examine_redcap_sickle: A rusty sickle, stuck in the ground.
examine_ship_mast_sail: The mast. The sail is up and full.
examine_ship_bowsprit: The bowsprit, pointing out to sea.
examine_ship_hammock: A crew hammock. Somebody's sleeping in it, or was.
examine_ship_round_table: A round table, bolted to the floor. A scratch won't budge it.
examine_ship_captain_bed: The captain's bed. Nicer than anything else on this ship.
examine_city_bus_stop: A bus stop. The timetable has given up.
examine_city_bottles: Empty bottles. Somebody had a night.
examine_city_planar_portal: A hole in the world, shimmering.
examine_city_sewer_entrance: A way down into the sewer.
examine_tahuya_cabin: A cabin in the woods. Maybe someone inside knows the way forward
examine_tahuya_firewood_shed: A firewood shed, stacked neatly. Too much wood to do anything with a scratch.
examine_tahuya_mushroom_light: A mushroom-shaped path light. It changes colour.
examine_cabin_connector_shelf: A shelf of odds and ends.
examine_cabin_curtain_window: A window with curtains. Dark outside.
examine_ship_bookshelf: The captain's books. Charts, logs, and one about knots that has been read to pieces.
examine_ship_writing_desk: The captain's desk, a chart held down by an inkpot. Much too solid to scratch at.
examine_ship_butcher_block: A butcher block with a cleaver stuck in it. Best not to ask what was on it last.
examine_ship_stew_pot: A pot of stew. It has been simmering since before anyone can remember.
examine_ship_cargo_stack: Crates and a sack, lashed down tight. Far too big to break with a scratch.
examine_waterdeep_gate_tower: A tower of the district wall. The watch is up there somewhere, watching.
examine_waterdeep_banner: A blue and silver banner. The City Watch's colours.
examine_tavern_keg_rack: Kegs of ale on a rack. Too sturdy to scratch open, sadly.
examine_tavern_notice_board: Notices: a lost dog, a room to let, and a reward for a rat. Hopefully a different rat.
examine_tavern_rug: A worn rug. It has soaked up a lot of ale.
examine_pantry_sack_pile: A pile of flour sacks, stitched tight. Too heavy to tear with a scratch.
examine_pantry_produce_basket: A basket of onions and apples. No cheese.
examine_chult_fallen_log: A fallen trunk, going soft with moss. Still too big to break with a scratch.
examine_chult_ruin_fragment: A carved block, half swallowed by the jungle. Something stood here once. Too heavy to scratch at.
examine_chult_great_tree: An enormous jungle tree. The rest of the jungle grew up around it.
examine_chult_falls: A waterfall. Cold spray all the way over here.
examine_chult_boulder: A big wet rock. Not going anywhere.
examine_chult_boulder_water: A rock sitting in the pool.
examine_temple_wall_carving: A carving set into the wall. Serpents, suns and faces, mostly.
examine_temple_toppled_pillar: A pillar lying in pieces. Too heavy to break with a scratch.
examine_temple_pillar_stump: The stump of a broken pillar. Solid stone.
examine_temple_grand_arch: A grand stone arch. It doesn't lead anywhere. It just stands there being grand.
examine_phlegethos_vent: A vent in the rock, breathing smoke. It smells like burnt hair.
examine_phlegethos_bone_heap: A heap of old bones. Several somebodies, a long time ago.
examine_phlegethos_iron_spikes: Rusted iron spikes driven into the rock. Best not to scratch at those.
examine_phlegethos_fortress_tower: A tower of the fortress wall. Something up there is glowing.
examine_phlegethos_banner: A black banner with an ember on it. Whoever's colours they are, they're winning down here.
examine_fey_lantern: A lantern on a crooked post. Nobody lit it. It just glows.
examine_desert_ribcage: The bones of something enormous. The skull alone is bigger than a cart.
examine_orc_tent: An orc tent of stitched hides. It smells exactly how it looks.
examine_orc_weapon_rack: A rack of orc axes and spears. Too heavy to budge with a scratch.
examine_orc_war_drum: An orc war drum. A rat-sized tap wouldn't make a sound.
examine_city_litter_bin: A litter bin. It smells promising.
examine_city_neon_bar: A neon sign that says BAR. One letter keeps flickering.
examine_city_neon_open: A neon sign that says OPEN. It's lying.
examine_city_steam_grate: A grate breathing steam. Warm, at least.
examine_sewer_pipe: An outflow pipe, dribbling something grey-green.
examine_sewer_graffiti: A tag nobody else can read.
examine_ship_deck_grating: A deck grating. Down through the gaps, the hold smells of bilge and rope.
examine_harbour_bollard: A mooring post, rope worn into it. Too solid to scratch at.
examine_harbour_rowboat: A rowboat, tied up. Somebody's going fishing later, or wishes they were.
examine_shop_sign_bread: A baker's sign. The smell got here first.
examine_shop_sign_fish: A fishmonger's sign. The smell got here first.
examine_shop_sign_barrel: A cooper's sign. Barrels made while you wait. Not while a rat waits.
examine_shop_sign_potion: The alchemist's sign. The bottle on it is a colour nothing should be.
examine_window_box: A window box. Somebody waters these.
examine_washing_line: Washing on a line. It's never going to dry in this harbour air.
examine_ship_foremast: The foremast, so called because it stands forward of the mainmast.
It could be called the mainmast if the mast abaft it were a mizzen, as on a ketch or yawl; but that would make this a different rig altogether.
This is a brig, so her masts are fore and main.
examine_astral_void: The astral sea, the space between worlds ... what's it doing here?
examine_city_park_fountain: A concrete fountain. The rain seems redundant.
examine_city_park_bench: A park bench. Every seat is wet.
examine_city_park_planter: A shrub in a concrete tub. Someone still trims it.
examine_city_newspaper_box: A newspaper behind glass. The paper has stayed dry.
